observations: Two blue retail boxes for MAXI Line Interactive UPS are stacked.
The boxes are clearly labeled 'MAXI' and '3000VA'.
The packaging features an illustration of a UPS unit with a digital display and rear power outlets.
A watermark 'BUCHITEK GLOBAL NETWORKS' is visible across the center of the image.
The actual UPS units are not visible; only the external cardboard packaging is shown.
The boxes appear to be closed, but it is impossible to tell if they are factory-sealed.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand 'MAXI' and capacity '3000VA' (equivalent to 3KVA) on the box.
The illustration on the box in photo 0 shows a front-panel digital display.
This specific alphanumeric model code is not visible on the shown faces of the box.
Reliability and capacity cannot be tested through a photo of a box.

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty, contain a different model, or contain a damaged unit.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual UPS units outside of the boxes.

risks.risk: The internal lead-acid batteries may be degraded, dead, or missing entirely.
risks.proof: A video of the UPS unit powering a load (e.g., a television or fan) while the UPS is unplugged from the wall outlet.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring a full set of new batteries.

risks.risk: The internal charging or inverter circuitry may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit successfully powering on, passing its self-test, and charging.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual UPS units removed from the boxes.
Photo of the specification sticker/plate on the back of the actual unit.
Video of the unit powered on and supporting a load while disconnected from mains power.
response.reason: Only the retail packaging is visible. Without seeing the actual item, its physical condition, and its functional state, a reliable valuation is not possible.
